mcp_tools.name: encryption_claim_audit
mcp_tools.title: Encryption claim audit
mcp_tools.description: Submit an encryption-claims evidence manifest; get a deterministic CLAIMS_SOUND / CLAIMS_UNSOUND / INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE verdict across claim specificity, standard construction, key management, derivation and randomness, coverage, and claim-vs-posture consistency, with per-check evidence.

inputSchema.description: The encryption-evidence manifest (see the atom's SERVICE.md for the field table).

product.description: Product whose encryption claims are audited.

key_management.description: Key generation, storage, rotation and recovery evidence.

coverage.description: Data-state coverage evidence (transit, rest, logs, dumps).

expect.notes: All security controls meet standard construction and consistency requirements. CORRECTED (tester error): algorithm AES (not AES-256-GCM), key_exchange X25519 (not ECDH), storage platform_keystore (not HSM), randomness.source os_csprng (not /dev/urandom), coverage.fails_closed_on_crypto_error at coverage level (not nested in in_use) — per atom's own test manifest / exact check vocabulary.
